notes.title: Experience the surprises in the Factory with Our Latest Update!
notes.notes:
Hey there! Long time no see! Have you missed us? Well, we've missed you too! Get ready to dive back into the excitement with the latest update to our game. Download it now and embark on thrilling new adventures.


[h1]New Character: CherryRuby[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/6647e807dc7e47d238d8da46b3df168ff9c170f9.png[/img]
Meet CherryRuby, the newest addition to our roster! Plus, did you know? CherryRuby is the avatar of the voice actress who brought to life, Lisa and Haley.


[h1]New Stage: Factory[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/9e02f25159a02890cc0af0b363438acc6925593f.png[/img]
Explore the depths of the Factory stage, where gears turn and machinery hums. Uncover its secrets as you navigate through its labyrinthine corridors. But what lies at the end of the factory? Prepare yourself for a surprise that will take your breath away!


[h1]New Translations:[/h1]
Our game interface and subtitles are now available in Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, French, Italian, and Portuguese.


[h1]New Game Mode:[/h1]
[spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/feec22c54df742e6880c4aeea6e1492a6656ae36.png[/img][/spoiler]
Take a break from the challenges of the other modes and enjoy a new special experience just for you.


[h1]New DLC: Babydolls set A[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2831090/Riding_to_Bounce_City__Babydoll_set_A/
Dress to impress with our latest DLC, featuring special costumes for Jeanne, Eve, and CherryRuby. Stand out in those intimate moments with these unique Babydolls.


[h1]Discount on All DLCs[/h1]
For a limited time, enjoy a discount on all [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/1892370/Riding_to_Bounce_City/]Riding to Bounce City DLCs[/url]! Remove censorship and customize your gameplay with special costumes for your favorite characters.
 

[h1]Join Our Community[/h1]
Your feedback helps shape the future of our game! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/RYHC52bywH]Official Discord server![/url] and share your thoughts with us.
Thanks,

notes.title: Unlock a World of Adventure: The Game Update You've Been Waiting For
notes.notes:
The moment you've been waiting for has finally arrived - our latest update is now available for download, and it's packed with exciting new features. Don't miss out on the action; download the update now!

[h1]What's Fresh in This Update:[/h1]
[h2]New Characters: [/h2]
Meet our two fantastic new characters, Mandy, the streamer, and Kate, the teacher.

Start your journey with a bang! Both Mandy and Kate now have brand-new introductions that will get you even more... excited to play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/4d23afeb26d829acf4c1aae0690b4c23d9ed2db8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/c135797bec692bedb0d681608ca5cee364b5d915.png[/img]

[h2]Revamped "Ravine" Music:[/h2]
The "Ravine" stage now boasts its own unique soundtrack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/4f737dca376fac2ce88cf8e40e0c8ad4a7b1e259.png[/img]

[h2]New Stage: "Highway Reprise": [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/fc7b082dc329b0b8197c504da3b293d83cc0d0dd.png[/img]
Brace yourself for the "Highway Reprise" stage, loaded with new enemies, challenging obstacles, and a new soundtrack inspired by elements of 8-bit music that will take you on a nostalgic journey. Get ready for a twist - your character now auto-shoots, and you can control the shooting direction with just the "spacebar."

[h2]New Game Mode: "Adventure":[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/85d8b06f5a255fbcb9b4afd168da0479acc8086d.png[/img]
Embark on a thrilling adventure with our new "Adventure" mode. Start with a random stage, character, outfit, and hat (if previously unlocked). Explore different paths, plan your journey, and unlock what you want, or just have fun with the ever-changing terrain. 
In this game mode, Cameras and "Clothing" will be unlocked for the equipped character/outfit by simply conquering the stage where these items are located!

[h2]New DLC Alert: Unleash Your Inner Feline![/h2]
In addition to our exciting update, we're thrilled to introduce a brand-new DLC that lets you transform Eve, Kate, and Roxanne into stylish feline characters, now available at a 40% discount for a limited time.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2594650/Riding_to_Bounce_City__Cat_set_A/



[h3]Limited-Time DLC Extravaganza[/h3]
For one week only, all of the Riding to Bounce City DLCs are available at a special discounted price. Don't miss out on this amazing deal.


Now's the time to join the excitement! Download the update and experience all these additions. We appreciate your continued support and dedication to our game.

If you have any feedback or run into any issues, join our [url=https://discord.gg/RYHC52bywH]Official Discord server![/url] and let us know. We can't wait to read your comments!

notes.title: Exciting Update Coming in September to Riding to Bounce City!
notes.notes:
Get ready for an exciting new update to [b]Riding to Bounce City[/b] this September! While we can't reveal all the details just yet, we can offer a sneak peek at what's in store:

[h1]New Characters:[/h1]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/b887c6b05f190400bc4dcdc46a157158e43d0c9a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/90fdd8a57047972023bbb851adec6ca84453c392.png[/img][/url]
[b]Mandy[/b]: The streamer.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/126bdbb1b8f1f6e4f3a3864255addb98090e4387.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/667b77e5f0f00ba8e91854eac161cb5b2d0add02.png[/img][/url]
[b]Kate[/b]: The teacher.

[h1]New Stage:[/h1]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/ed7f677eabd2c2f9b7ce6a0d3d30d16a1c329df8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/8025462e1aefaae7cc25ee74fa8316ea98de6f51.png[/img][/url]
[b]Highway Reprise[/b]: Take the wheel and experience the thrill of the road with this new Stage filled with challenges.

[h1]New Game Mode:[/h1]

[b]Adventure (random)[/b]: Looking for a different challenge every time? This mode will randomize everything in the game to offer you a unique experience in each race! Plus, unlock rewards based on the path you choose.


Stay tuned for more exciting news as we continue adding more content!


Join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/RYHC52bywH]Official Discord server![/url] for the latest updates and to share your in-game experiences!
